files.content:
# Examples/iOS bottom sheet

A narrow, touch-first iOS bottom sheet without search.

Install emoji-picker-react 5 or later, import app.css and picker.css, then render <Shell className="ios-sheet" />. For CSS Modules, import picker.module.css and pass styles.picker as className. The component includes its app context; adapt its insertion callback to your product.
